articles.title: Crypto political group details list of U.S. congressional allies its backing this year
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto, a member group that rates the crypto friendliness of politicians, is supporting 32 U.S. House incumbents, with more endorsements coming.

articles.title: Zondacrypto boss seeks leniency for testimony on political ties: Report
articles.snippet: Przemysław Kral reportedly faces a fraud charge and is cooperating with Polish prosecutors as estimated customer losses reach $650 million.

articles.title: ECB defends digital euro privacy as CBDCs face global scrutiny
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the Eurosystem would not identify digital euro users as central bank digital currencies face privacy concerns worldwide.

articles.title: We are so back! Bitcoin’s 23% rally on US debt policy: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: The US may face a debt crisis within three years according to Ray Dalio, and debt-related issues helped fuel a rally in Bitcoin that could mark the beginning of a new cycle.

articles.title: Most Americans Say Trump's Crypto Profits Cross the Line: Poll
articles.snippet: A Reuters/Ipsos survey found 63% of Americans view the Trump family's crypto profits as inappropriate, with even half of the president's fellow Republicans saying his business interests sway his decisions.
